run_train_gan_from_folder: run a lightweight GAN training from a folder of images with configurable hyperparameters
generate_images_from_trained_gan: generate sample images from a trained lightweight GAN model checkpoint
generate_interpolation_gan: generate interpolation images between latent vectors using a trained GAN model
show_gan_training_progress: show the current training progress of a lightweight GAN model with sample images
set_random_seed_for_reproducibility: set a random seed for PyTorch, NumPy, and Python to ensure reproducible results
